title: Allowance App Chore-to-Payout Latency
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allowance:txn
| search event_type="chore_payout" payout_delay_hr=*
| stats avg(payout_delay_hr) as avg_payout_delay_hr perc90(payout_delay_hr) as p90_payout_delay_hr count as samples by child_name
| sort 0 - avg_payout_delay_hr
description: Measures chore payout latency by child.
value: Slow payout erodes trust in the system, so a simple latency view helps keep the reward loop credible.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for chore payout latency to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 chore payout latency.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long chore payout latency usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
